title: A publication's changed members deflate in parallel under the caller's execution budget
decision: retained, implemented for the managed preservation-write boundary; the remaining ADR 0031 read-session rows stay open
code_state: litchi-core execution dimensions and scoped facility; soapberry-zip bounded write session and preservation wave; litchi-opc managed source-backed bridge; retained probes and packet
authority: change 0652 decision 6: Parallel deflate accepts ADR 0031; design and balance rule from change 0624; execution-context shape and gates from change 0615
reason_codes: changed Deflate members are independent pure generation tasks and can be prepared before publication without moving the emission fence
the wave width is derived from the changed-set remainder after its largest member, measured at the ZIP publication boundary rather than assumed from isolated codec timings
Workers, CpuTasks, worker-state memory, cancellation and an optional caller facility are admitted before the first member is compressed
published bytes, error order, physical local order, cancellation refusal and sink-untouched budget refusal remain deterministic across widths
the ordinary save and other routes without an ExecutionContext are explicitly excluded from the speedup scope
accepted ADR 0031's IoConcurrency and existing read-session composition rows are not silently counted as implemented

accepted_evidence.balance_rule: warm ZIP sweep and cold OPC sweep establish the 8 KiB warm and 64 KiB pool-building remainder thresholds, with the largest-member bound and per-task-floor narrowing
accepted_evidence.publication_timing: paired managed source-backed fixture timings at widths 1/2/4/8 and with a caller facility, with a same-window A/A floor per row
accepted_evidence.default_path: paired harness A/B timing rows for managed and unmanaged selectors, with output digests identical and ordinary-save rows reported without a claim
accepted_evidence.identity: 305 admitted OOXML fixtures publish identical digests at every width and on the caller facility; 11 refusal cases retain their text
accepted_evidence.determinism: one width-eight session publishes the same plan seventeen times with identical output
accepted_evidence.correctness: tests cover errors in plan order, cancellation before output, physical-versus-central order, appended members, stored/precompressed exclusions and caller-facility scheduling
accepted_evidence.resource_counts: worker-state minor faults and peak RSS are retained for 200 real publications; the write wave keeps one compressor per member and reserves a measured worker envelope

accepted_costs.cold_pool: a 28 KiB remainder loses on a cold pool but wins on a caller facility; the 64 KiB cold threshold is retained from the measured crossover
accepted_costs.dominant_member: the one-dominant real fixture is 0.976x at width two against a 0.35% A/A floor and 1.21x at widths four and eight; it is reported rather than averaged away
accepted_costs.publication_bound: the route audits and copies unchanged members, so end-to-end gains are lower than isolated Deflate speedups
accepted_costs.memory: peak RSS rises with local workers; the write session reserves 640 KiB per admitted worker
accepted_costs.host_contention: the retained contended window shows large losses on busy CPUs, so no claim is registered

known_gaps.adr_0031_read_sessions: Resource::IoConcurrency is absent; soapberry_zip::office::ParallelReadSession remains eager and the CFB bulk and source-backed ordered readers do not consume shared Workers/CpuTasks or a caller ScopedWorkers facility
known_gaps.ordinary_save: PackageWriter ordinary saves carry no ExecutionContext or write session and are publication-bound
known_gaps.other_writers: the streaming writer, eager PackageWriter path, unmanaged packages and splice/replay path are outside this change
known_gaps.measurement: cold-cache, physical-device, cross-platform and compression-level behavior were not measured; instruction counts were not taken
known_gaps.corpus: fixture changed sets use deterministic compact re-serialization and do not represent every producer's editor output

withheld: any saving for an ordinary, eager, unmanaged, streaming or replay publication
any statement that accepted ADR 0031's three read-session rows are complete

provenance.validation: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo check, test and clippy --all-targets for litchi-core, soapberry-zip and litchi-opc with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
